business_problem: Joulica needed to help enterprises act on customer journey data in real time and also remove adoption barriers for large organizations that had standardized on Google Cloud and wanted analytics platforms to fit their existing data and governance environments.
solution_summary: Joulica added native Google Cloud support to its real-time analytics platform so customer interaction data and newer AI-agent telemetry could be analyzed inside enterprise cloud environments. BigQuery is a key part of the design, enabling customers to query multiple years of detailed customer journey data across phone, chat, email, websites, mobile apps, surveys, and sentiment streams while still getting answers in seconds. On top of that data layer, Joulica is building what it calls agentic analytics by combining Agent Development Kit capabilities with OpenTelemetry integrations to capture how AI agents reason through tasks, which tools they use, and what outcomes they deliver. This lets organizations monitor both human customer journeys and AI-powered interactions from one analytical foundation. The result is a platform that shortens time-to-insight, helps teams identify friction faster, and positions Joulica to support more Fortune 50 customers on Google Cloud.

business_outcome: Joulica broadened its enterprise reach, returns complex analytical answers in 2-5 seconds, cuts customer time-to-insight by 70%, and extends its platform from customer journey analytics into AI-agent performance analytics.
